Musk ordered Starlink slowdown impacting Ukraine drones, report says

Elon Musk ordered a slowdown of the Starlink satellite internet service used by Ukraine, which reportedly crippled the operation of Ukrainian drones, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The disruption, which began on October 14, affected both offensive and interceptor drones. Former President Donald Trump denied ordering any restrictions, while US officials provided conflicting accounts regarding whether Musk acted independently. Separately, Trump warned Ukraine that it was 'time to make a deal' to end the war.
